summary: Celestica Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the results of its 2026 annual meeting of shareholders held May 19, 2026. Matters voted included election of directors, ratification of auditor appointment, and an advisory vote on executive compensation. No special-situation transaction, strategic review, activist campaign, or capital return is described. The filing is a routine current report on shareholder vote outcomes and a related press release. As a non-US filer incorporated in Ontario, the filing maps to a standard Item 5.07 disclosure with no special-situation implications.
